shortDescription: An enterprise DevOps and IT Admin command browser for mission workspaces, multi-pane operations, local tools, and sanitized handoff evidence.
storeDescription: TAHAI Web Services Browser is built for technical operators who live across cloud consoles, admin portals, logs, runbooks, documentation, tickets, and release evidence.
Mission Control turns tabs into operational workspaces with split, tri-view, quad, focus-pane, runbook, timeline, local tools, and evidence/export surfaces.

The browser is local-first and intentionally does not store PSA/API/provider secrets. IT Docs and PSA features are browser-side references/contracts unless connected through authorized server-side services later.
ageRatingNotes: No user-generated social sharing, no commerce inside the app, no adult content. Browser can access user-entered websites; Store rating must be completed honestly in Partner Center.
